title: A minimization problem for a cooperative system with a degenerate Bernoulli weight
summary: In this paper, we study local minimizers of the energy functional$J(\mathbf{u}) = \int_D (|\nabla \mathbf{u}|^2 + Q^2(x)χ_{Ω_{\mathbf{u}}})\,dx$ which give rise to a singular cooperative system. Here \(\mathbf{u}=(u_1,\dots,u_m): D\to\R_+^m\) is a vector-valued unknown function, \(Ω_{\mathbf{u}}:=\{|\mathbf{u}|>0\}\) is the positive set, \(χ_{Ω_{\mathbf{u}}}\) is the characteristic function of the positive set \(Ω_{\mathbf{u}}\), and \(Q(x)\) is the Bernoulli weight function.
